name: elohim-agent
description: Agentic capability vocabulary for interpreting generic Manifest and Agent atoms as skills, agents, hooks, policies, validators, counters, signals, and runtime projection bindings.

agent-manifest-json.description: JSON serialization for agentic capability app-manifest artifacts.

USES.description: An agent or agent spec uses a declared capability.

ACTIVATES.description: An MCP activation profile selects a reusable server definition for runtime registration.

INSTRUCTS.description: A standing instruction surface instructs an executable agent role.

GOVERNS.description: A policy governs an agentic artifact.

VALIDATES.description: A validator checks a hook, policy, projection binding, or artifact payload.

BINDS.description: A hook binds lifecycle phases and matchers to validation or policy surfaces.

DERIVED_FROM.description: A signal is interpreted from events or counter state.

PROJECTS.description: A projection binding maps canonical artifacts to runtime surfaces.

capability-used.description: An agentic capability was selected or used by an execution surface.

lifecycle-event-observed.description: A lifecycle occurrence relevant to hooks, policies, counters, or signals was observed.

validation-executed.description: A deterministic validator contract was evaluated.

projection-drift-detected.description: A projected runtime surface diverged from its canonical agentic capability source.

policy-violation-detected.description: Observed behavior or projected configuration violated a declared policy.

capability-usable.description: The declared capability can be selected, interpreted, or projected by an execution surface.

projection-drift.description: A runtime projection differs from the canonical agentic capability artifact.

policy-violation.description: Behavior, configuration, or binding violates a declared governance rule.

validator-deterministic.description: A validator yields deterministic results for its declared input shape and fuel bound.
